sn40.10:48.1: Sādhu kho devānam inda dhamme aveccapasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti || svākhyāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti || dhamme aveccapasādena samannāgamanahetu kho devānam inda evam idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam upapajjanti || te aññe deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhanti dibbena āyunā || pe || dibbehi poṭṭhabbehīti
sn40.10:54.1: Sādhu kho devānam inda ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṃ hoti || akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhuñjissehi viññuppasatthehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanahetu kho devānam inda evam idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam upapajjanti || te aññe deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhanti || dibbena āyunā dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibbena adhipateyyena dibbehi rūpehi dibbehi saddehi dibbehi gandhehi dibbehi rasehi dibbehi poṭṭhabbehīti || || Sādhu kho mārisa Moggalāna buddhe aveccapasādena samannāgamanaṃ
